svg.text: FinSight AI, Phase 1: life of a document - states and transitions
States tracked per DocumentVersion: received, stored, processing, done (committed), failed, needs review (chunk-level / whole-document), superseded, rejected.
Grounded in phase1_mvp_plan.md (Document/DocumentVersion) and the config switch guide (5.27). Aurora is the source of truth.
A. Happy path and virus rejection
State is per DocumentVersion. Old answers remain valid while a new version processes. Old version becomes superseded only when the new version commits.
Virus scan fails after file lands in S3.
File never queued or stored visibly.
B. Exits from processing, needs review and version transitions
failed covers errors, retries exhausted, and worker heartbeat timeout. needs review is split by scope. Old versions become superseded on new version commit.
Document still commits in one transaction.
Exit only by uploading corrected file as Update.
Wholly unreadable or fails required validation.
Does not commit. No visible chunks/vectors.
Not ready for Q&A or citations.
Exit only by uploading corrected file as Update.
a new version commits. Kept for version_retention_days.
Old answers/citations that reference it remain valid.
Chunks read-only. Answer cache cleared on update.

version commits atomically; old/new never mixed.
new version commits → old becomes superseded
upload corrected file as Update → new version

g.text: Virus scan after file lands. Fail → rejected (terminal). Pass → stored, job queued.
SQS/Step Functions worker picks job for this version.
All checks pass. Commit in one transaction. Chunk-level flags may still allow commit with flagged chunks.
Step error, retries exhausted after job_max_receive_count, or worker timeout/death (heartbeat lost).
Issues on some chunks only. Document still commits; flagged chunks excluded from numbers/citations.
Wholly unreadable or fails required validation. No commit; no visible chunks/vectors.
After retries/DLQ and alert. User sees "please upload again". Restart by re-uploading (new or Update).
No in-app reviewer in Phase 1. Exit only by uploading a corrected file as an Update.
Update or reprocess creates new version. Old becomes superseded on new version commit atomically; old/new never mixed.

svg.text: D. Invariants enforced by core and data rules
• State is per DocumentVersion. Ready only after commit. processing, failed, rejected, and whole-document needs_review are never cited.
• One transaction per version. On new version commit, previous version becomes superseded. Document stamp updates in the same transaction.
• Retries idempotent (job id + upsert on stable chunk id). Heartbeat/worker timeout → failed. SQS/DLQ + alerts after job_max_receive_count.
• Virus scan after file lands → rejected if fails (never queued/stored). Numbers from code only; chunk-level needs_review chunks flagged and excluded.
• Whole-document needs_review does not commit. No in-app reviewer in Phase 1 — exit only by uploading a corrected file as an Update.
• Reprocess: stay on old done version until new version commits atomically; old/new vectors never mixed. Stable chunk ids reused where unchanged.
• Failed is terminal after retries/DLQ — user sees "please upload again", restart by re-uploading. Delete separate (soft then purge), audit entry remains.
Config: consistency.job_max_receive_count, worker/heartbeat timeout, documents.version_retention_days, documents.deleted_retention_days, virus scan settings.
States: received, stored, processing, committed/done, failed, needs_review (chunk-level/whole-document), superseded, rejected. committed = UI/answer-facing done.
